# Everyone the release alert must reach.
#
# One GitHub handle per line. `#` starts a comment (inline is fine); blank
# lines are ignored. Parsed by .github/scripts/release_roster.sh, which is the
# ONLY thing that should read this file.
#
# Two consumers:
#   • .github/scripts/release_alert_body.sh — builds the @mention line
#   • .github/workflows/release-ack.yaml    — the denominator for the ack tally
#
# This is a HAND-MAINTAINED MIRROR of the Disasters-Learning-Portal/disasters
# team. It is not read from the org API, because the default GITHUB_TOKEN is
# repo-scoped and gets 403 on GET /orgs/{org}/teams/{slug}/members — reading the
# team live would mean granting a PAT `Organization permissions -> Members: Read`
# and inheriting that PAT's expiry as a new way for the alert to break silently.
#
# Refresh it by hand when the team changes:
#
#   gh api orgs/Disasters-Learning-Portal/teams/disasters/members --jq '.[].login'
#
# Matching is case-insensitive, so casing here is cosmetic.
#
# Last synced with the team: 2026-08-25
